title: Sicilian Defense: Sveshnikov Variation
line: Black leaves a hole in the center to chase White's knights and get active pieces.

steps.text: Here Black's knight came out before the pawn in front of the queen moved, and White took in the center.
Bring the other knight out to attack the pawn on e4.

also.e7e6: That is also played. This lesson goes on with the knight.
also.g7g6: That is the Accelerated Dragon, another main line. This lesson goes on with the knight.

steps.text: Push the pawn on e7 two squares. It kicks the knight, though it leaves a hole on d5.
steps.after: The knight jumps to b5 and eyes d6.

steps.text: Push the pawn on d7 one square. It keeps the knight out of d6.
Push the pawn on a7 one square to kick the knight away.
steps.after: The knight goes to the edge.

steps.text: Push the pawn on b7 two squares. It keeps the knight on the edge and takes space.
Take back with the pawn. Your pawns look loose, but you keep both bishops.
Push the pawn on f6 one square. It hits White's center pawn on e4.
steps.after: Your pawn hits e4, and White's knight on a3 is still stuck on the edge.

summary: The Sveshnikov gives up a central square to chase White's knights, and Black's pieces get room.
